description: Initialization: Construct by earliest completion, then perform up to 16 re-timing steps per inserted task. At each step select the best feasible neighbor by total adjacent transformation time; temporarily forbid returning to the removed window/start unless it improves the best result. Return the best visited timeline.

Reassignment: Remove released observations and apply the same rule to reconsidered tasks. Re-timing can change only observations inserted during this call; other observations stay fixed. Return no change if the complete timeline is unchanged or infeasible.
